$comment: The source of sf-content-editor's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js); standard simai.smart-component 1.4, vocabulary 1.1.5. Written for simai/ui-editor by the owner's decision of 2026-11-01 (the text editor starts once the content types are out); behaviour per ui-editor prototypes/content-editor.html and the content standard, sections 6, 7 and 9. Written by hand in the 1.4 form on the shape of sf-mail-structure; x-decisions says how each point was decided.

document.x-markup: a property: a host has the Document as an object; the editor works on its own copy and never writes this property back.
document.summary: The page: a Composition Document of the profile structured-content. Setting a new one starts editing it; the one the editor sent in change is recognised and kept.

kinds.summary: The kinds the / menu and the + of the gutter offer, by id (paragraph, heading-2, heading-3, list, ordered-list, quote, alert, details, steps, table, figure, file, code, divider, tabs, card, grid, html). Empty offers the first fourteen.

editor-manifests.summary: Composition editor manifests of a host's own types, or ones that replace the Framework's for a type: the parameters form of a block is built from them.

parameters.summary: Where a chosen block's parameters beyond its quick choices are edited: popover (an sf-popover from the block's quick toolbar) or host (the host draws them from the params event, as a page editor's Properties panel does).

sources.x-markup: a property: {<stored src>: <address to show it from>}; a host that keeps files by reference (an IndexedDB key, a storage id) sets it.
sources.summary: Where a picture's or file's stored value is shown from: a map of the value a host answered with to an address the browser loads.

embed.summary: The editor stands in a host's box (a layout's outlet) as that box's text: no sheet of its own (no reading width, no padding), the text from the box's edge, the gutter outside the box in the host's margin (68px beside a box of 640px and wider, 36px beside a narrower one), the blocks in the rendered page's content rhythm (the text space between blocks, the section space before a heading). Opening it moves no line of the rendered page.

title-field.summary: Whether the page's title field is drawn: auto shows it on a sheet and hides it embedded; shown and hidden decide it. A hidden title keeps the Document's data.title as it is.

label.summary: The accessible name of the page's blocks.

change.x-summary: vocabulary §5 change: the Document changed (typing, a split or a join, a block made, moved, removed, a parameter, undo); the editor stores nothing, the host does. reason names what happened.
change.summary: The page changed: {document, reason}. The host saves the document.

select.x-summary: vocabulary §5 select: blocks were chosen with Esc and the arrows, or the choice was let go (ids empty).
select.summary: These blocks are chosen: {ids}; empty when none is.

leave.x-summary: Esc while blocks are chosen: the choice is let go and the person may be taken back (a page editor returns to its layout). A verb of this element.
leave.summary: Esc with blocks chosen: the person asks to leave the text.

params.x-summary: One block was chosen (Esc, a press in the gutter or on a picture), or its «Parameters…» was asked for (open true): its type's editor-manifest fields with their values, words, choices, defaults and a warning (a picture with no alt), for a host's panel. id empty when no one block is chosen. A verb of this element.
params.summary: The chosen block's parameters for a host's panel: {id, type, kind, label, fields, open}; id empty when none is chosen.

file.x-summary: A file was dropped on the page, pasted, or given to an empty picture's or file's zone: the File and the block it stands in (a picture for an image, a file block for any other type). The block shows it at once; the host keeps the file and answers with answer-file. A verb of this element.
file.summary: A file to keep: {file, block, type}, type being the block's (content.figure or content.file). The host stores the file and calls answer-file with {block, value, href} or {block, reason}.

edit.x-summary: put the caret in a block (the first one with no id); a block with nothing to type in is chosen instead; refused unknown
edit.summary: Start typing in a block, the first with no id; refused unknown for a block not in the page.

select.x-summary: choose blocks of one flow as Esc does; refused unknown, not-siblings
select.summary: Choose blocks as Esc and Shift+arrows do; refused unknown, not-siblings.

x-returns.description: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason: unknown | not-siblings}

insert.x-summary: make a block of a kind after a block, or at the end; refused unknown
insert.summary: Make a block of an offered kind after a block, or at the end of the page; refused unknown.

undo.x-summary: one step back, as ⌘Z; refused empty
undo.summary: One step back, as ⌘Z; refused empty with nothing to undo.

redo.x-summary: one step forward, as ⇧⌘Z; refused empty
redo.summary: One step forward, as ⇧⌘Z; refused empty.

value.summary: the value as the field takes it: a choice's or a text's string, a toggle's boolean, an integer; empty takes it out

set-parameter.x-summary: write one of a block's parameters as the host's panel set it; a value equal to its default (or empty) is taken out; refused unknown, invalid
set-parameter.summary: Write a block's parameter from a host's panel; empty or the default takes it out; refused unknown or invalid.

x-returns.description: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason: unknown | invalid}

answer-file.x-summary: the host's answer to a file event: value and href (a picture keeps value in data.src and is shown from href; a file block keeps both, as data.value and data.href, with the file's name, type and size), or reason (the block shows it with a retry), or progress 0-100 on the way; refused unknown for a block with no file on its way
answer-file.summary: Answer a file event: {block, value, href} stores the picture or file, {block, reason} shows the refusal with a retry, {block, progress} moves the bar; refused unknown.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the sheet's frame; the blocks are drawn by js/view.js.

accessibility.x-keys: one tab stop on the field last typed in; the arrows go between fields at a field's first and last line; Esc chooses the block, then the arrows choose blocks, Shift extends, Enter goes back to typing and Esc leaves; the / list is a listbox the field points at with aria-activedescendant; the grip opens its menu with Enter; what happened is said in a status line

x-summary: The content mode of the SIMAI page editor: a page typed as one flow over a Composition Document (structured-content). Enter and Backspace split and join blocks, Markdown at a line's start and / change a block's kind, the gutter's + and grip (in the margin, outside the text) add, move and open a block's menu, each menu at what opened it, a selection gets the inline bar, Esc chooses blocks, a paste becomes blocks through html@1, a table goes by Tab. A chosen block shows its quick choices over it and gives the rest to the host's panel (or a popover). A picture is dropped, pasted or picked on the page and kept by the host. The element saves nothing: it sends the new Document in change.

x-source.converted: written by hand (2026-11-01) from the accepted prototype, on the Framework's content types (ui-source 339f094b, pair ui-e4f44b2523ff): the keys, the menus and the words are the prototype's; the model is the Composition Document instead of the prototype's flat list

x-decisions: names: sf-content-editor, as the content standard (section 6) names it.

shape: a leaf that draws its blocks itself (plain DOM, js/view.js), because sf-inline-editor owns a field while it is typed in; its frame, the gutter, the quick toolbar and the / list are its own markup, its menus one sf-context-menu, its parameters' popover one sf-popover, a picture's drop zone sf-file-upload.

inline editing: every inline field is a session of sf-inline-editor 1.2.0 (marks, links, atoms, its bar); the editor takes Enter, Backspace at the start, Esc and the arrows at a field's edge before the session does, and shows the session's bar over a selection only.
unknown: a node of a type the editor does not know is drawn as a closed card and kept byte for byte; only moved or removed whole.
storage: none. Every change is a change event with the whole Document; the host saves it and may set it back, which the editor recognises.
events: change and select are vocabulary §5 verbs; leave is this element's own.

gutter (owner, 2026-11-01): a fixed 56px margin left of the text holds the + and the grip, 24px each, 4px apart, centred on the block's first line; it never overlaps the text. It stands 4px outside a block's highlight. A sheet narrower than 640px has a 32px margin with the + above the grip, and the grip's menu also holds «Add below»; on a coarse pointer the gutter stays with the caret's block while one types. It follows the block under the pointer or the caret, fades in 120ms (none under reduced motion) and waits 150ms before it leaves.

menus (owner, 2026-11-01): the + and grip menus open under their trigger, left edges aligned, through sf-context-menu.openFor on the native button inside sf-icon-button (the host is display: contents and has no box); they flip above and have a search field over name, search words and the Markdown shortcut. The / list opens under the caret and flips inside the scroller.

parameters (owner, 2026-11-01): three places. The content is typed in the block; a choice of two to six options is a quick toggle over the chosen block (six, so a picture's ratios are one); the rest is the host's panel (parameters: host, the params event and set-parameter) or an sf-popover from the quick toolbar. The form is the type's composition-editor-manifest, a host's own first; a value equal to its default is not written. The floating form and the quiet button on each block are gone.

pictures (owner, 2026-11-01): an empty picture is a drop zone the width of the text (sf-file-upload), with «Link» for an address. A file dropped anywhere makes a picture at the drop line, a pasted one at the caret; it shows at once from an object URL, goes to the host in the file event, and the host answers with answer-file {value, href} or {reason}. sources maps a stored value to where it is shown from. A file block (content.file, 1.2.0) is the same drop zone for any file; any file that is not an image dropped on the page makes one; it draws sf-download-file's row, its name typed in place, its address in the parameters.

version 1.2.4: the Framework elements it draws, finds and listens to are named by their new tags (Smart component naming of 2026-11-02, sf-[set]-<block>): the gutter is sf-button-icon, the block menu sf-menu-context, inline fields are edited through sf-editor-inline (its sf-editor-inline-* events). The rule relations and the registry ids follow (cl-<new>, smart.<new>; the package reference pro.package.json of the pair). The former tags stay dated aliases of the Framework until 2027-01-01; public CSS variables and classes keep their names. No visible change. Needs the SIMAI Framework pair with the tag renames (core.runtime 1.21.0).

version 1.3.0: the tag is sf-editor-content (naming decision 2026-11-02: sf-[set]-<block>[-<variant>]; rename plan R2); the folder editor-content, the id smart.editor-content and the bundle cl-editor-content follow it. sf-content-editor stays a dated alias until 2027-01-01: a subclass the Smart base defines beside the new tag, listed in the package rule, in sheets as :is(sf-editor-content, sf-content-editor), its events named after the tag followed by their former names (ui-source change journal tag-sf-content-editor-to-sf-editor-content, path-smart-content-editor-to-editor-content).

version 1.4.0 (G-15, owner request msg-dd87f2741a7b48448d5c; ui-control control/ui-editor/CONTENT-IN-LAYOUT-GAPS.md): in a layout's outlet the editor drew its own sheet, so on opening the text moved right by the gutter's margin and down by the sheet's padding and the title, and the outlet grew by a third. New settings embed (boolean) and title-field (auto | shown | hidden). Embedded, the sheet has no reading width and no padding; --sf-content-editor-margin is 0, so the gutter's own formula puts it outside the box, in the host's margin; the top-level blocks take the Framework's content rhythm (simai.vertical-sizing: --sf-content--space-text between blocks, --sf-content--space-section before a heading of level 2 to 6, the title's text space after it) instead of the sheet's quarter step, and a block's highlight padding is taken back by an equal negative margin, so it moves no line. The title field is hidden embedded unless title-field says shown; a hidden title is out of ↑, ↓ and Tab and keeps data.title. The rendered page's own spacing for figures, dividers and notes (no margin) is not copied: the rhythm is the contract's.

version 1.4.1 (2026-11-07): a patch. A file row's icon comes from the Composition's own table: view.js imports fileIcon from core/js/composition/file-size.mjs (core.runtime 1.32.0) instead of keeping a copy of its FILE_ICONS. Same icons, same fallback (download); no visible change. Needs the SIMAI Framework pair with core.runtime 1.32.0.

version 1.4.2 (2026-11-08): a patch (a look, embed only). SIMAI Framework's content heading ladder (tokens.typography 1.2.0, docs review R022, the pair ui-5edc71bd6936) puts the heading space and a block before an h2 and a block before an h3-h6, with half the heading's space under it. Embedded, the editor kept the earlier section space before every heading, so on opening an h2 rose 24px (16px on a phone) and the text after it with it (probe editor-content-embed). The embedded block margins now read the same tokens as the rendered page (--sf-heading--space-top, --sf-content--space-block, --sf-heading--space-bottom). Not embedded, nothing changes.

version 1.4.3 (2026-11-08): a patch (first paint only). static/sheets.json no longer lists utility/headers/default/css/default.min.css: SIMAI Framework utility.headers 1.1.0 asks for that sheet only for a whole class token h1..h6 (its former rule matched h1..h6 inside ids, modifiers and SVG path data), and none of the snapshots has one; the sheet styled only the h1..h6 tags with the heading tokens core.css already gives them. Code, settings, values and events are unchanged.

version 1.4.4 (2026-11-09): a patch (no visible change). The block plus, the grip, the quick panel's resting choices and the drop zone's actions ask sf-button and sf-button-icon for appearance="ghost", the look SIMAI Framework now calls ghost (decision C15, sf-button 1.7.0 and sf-button-icon of the pair ui-d6f01121baca); link is its former name, a dated alias until 2027-01-01, drawn the same. Settings, values and events are unchanged.

version 1.4.5 (2026-11-09): a patch, for the SIMAI Framework pair with the shadow places (C20, owner 2026-11-08; core.runtime >= 1.43.0). The quick toolbar and a picture's upload bar read the overlay place (--sf-surface-popup, --sf-shadow-overlay, --sf-on-surface-popup-variant) instead of elevation step 2, and the / list reads it instead of step 3. These are the values the former names resolve to on that pair (level 2 and 3 are overlay, level 2's surface joins popup), so nothing moves against it; the former names stay dated aliases until 2027-01-01. Settings, values and events are unchanged.

version 1.4.6 (2026-11-09): a patch (first paint only). The first-paint snapshots are retaken over SIMAI Framework ui-cb287da78ab1 (the pair's elements now print data-sf-size-relative on sf-icon and the other markup of that pair); static/sheets.json is unchanged (no sheet drift). Code, settings, values and events are unchanged.

version 1.4.7 (2026-11-10): a patch (no visible change; comments, docs, probe). Over SIMAI Framework ui-b4a77681f0a7 the 1/3 control is 28 on a desktop (C27, owner 2026-11-09): the gutter's + and grip keep following --sf-ui-1/3--control-height, with no local 24, as sf-editor 1.2.3 does (editor-6b1736f863ee). The sheet keeps the gutter inside its own start inset (--sf-content-editor-margin is max(--sf-space-7, gutter + reach)); embedded, the gutter still stands in the host's margin (G-15: opening moves no line), and the docs now give that room from the ladder instead of a fixed 68px / 36px: two 1/3 controls, two gaps and the reach beside a box of 640px and wider (76px on a desktop), one control beside a narrower one. Probe p12-gutter-outside-text reads the control height from the token instead of 24 and checks the gutter stands on screen (x >= 0). Code, settings, values, events and the drawing are unchanged.

version 1.4.8 (2026-11-10): a patch (first paint only). The first-paint snapshots are retaken over SIMAI Framework ui-2bd5a3ab478a: the pair's sf-menu-context prints its panel without the flex utility class (class="sf-context-menu"); static/sheets.json is unchanged (no sheet drift). Code, settings, values and events are unchanged.

$comment: The editor draws its gutter as sf-button-icon, its marks as sf-icon, the quick toolbar's words as sf-button,
and every inline field is edited through sf-editor-inline, so those come with it. The block menu (sf-menu-context),
the parameters' popover and form (sf-popover, sf-switch, sf-dropdown, sf-input) and a picture's drop zone and
progress (sf-file-upload, sf-progress-bar) open on a press or with an empty picture, so they are fetched after the page is ready.

change.const: Every change dispatches change {document, reason} with the whole Document; nothing is stored by the element. select {ids} says which blocks are chosen; leave {} is Esc with blocks chosen; params {id, type, kind, label, fields, open} is the chosen block's parameters for a host's panel; file {file, block, type} hands a picture or a file to the host, which answers with answer-file.

untrusted_inputs: the Document's text, drawn as text
pasted HTML, read through the html@1 subset
link addresses, kept only when safe

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-content-editor wherever a person writes the content of a page (a Composition Document of the profile structured-content).
do_not: Do not store the page in the element; listen for change and save the document it carries
Do not write a parameter equal to its default; the editor already leaves it out
Do not turn an unknown block into a paragraph; the editor keeps it as it is
Do not keep a dropped picture in the Document as a data: URL; store the file from the file event and answer with answer-file

accessibility.focus: One tab stop, on the field last typed in. Esc chooses the block it is in; the arrows choose others, Enter types again. The / list is announced through aria-activedescendant; changes are said in a status line.

changes: Draws and finds the renamed Framework elements by their new tags (the gutter is sf-button-icon, the block menu sf-menu-context, inline fields are edited through sf-editor-inline (its sf-editor-inline-* events)); the rule relations name cl-<new>. Needs the SIMAI Framework pair with the tag renames (core.runtime 1.21.0). No visible change. Nothing to change for a host on that pair; a host that writes the former tags keeps working until 2027-01-01.

The tag is sf-editor-content (rename plan R2, naming decision 2026-11-02: sf-[set]-<block>); the folder editor-content, the id smart.editor-content and the bundle cl-editor-content follow it (were content-editor, smart.content-editor, cl-content-editor). sf-content-editor stays a dated alias until 2027-01-01: old markup upgrades as this element, the Loader forwards cl-content-editor, and every event fires under its former name as well, with the same detail. Public CSS variables and classes keep their names. Needs the SIMAI Framework pair whose package reference lists the former tag (core.runtime 1.22.0). Nothing to change for a host until 2027-01-01; new markup writes sf-editor-content.

New settings embed and title-field (G-15): embedded, the editor stands in a host's box as its text, with no sheet of its own, the gutter in the host's margin and the rendered page's content rhythm; the title field is optional (auto hides it embedded). Nothing changes for a host that sets neither. A host that embeds the editor removes its own overrides of the sheet's padding, width and background and keeps room for the gutter in its margin.
